hook_line: AIRBNB RECREATES K3G'S RAICHAND HOUSE IN MUMBAI, BOOKINGS OPEN NOVEMBER 23

hook_stat.sub: Invitations for the free two-hour At Home with the Raichands experience in Mumbai

stats.label: Price of the two-hour experience — guests arrange their own travel to Mumbai
The experience runs December 1 to 6, 2026 in Mumbai
Anniversary of Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham that the experience marks

diaspora_bullets: Booking requests open Monday, November 23 at 12 p.m. IST at airbnb.com/k3g
Each spot covers one guest plus a companion
news_summary: Airbnb has recreated the Raichand House from Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham in Mumbai as At Home with the Raichands, a two-hour experience marking the Hindi film's 25th anniversary.
payoff: Requests open November 23 and the free experience runs December 1 to 6, with 180 invitations in total.
